statement.zh: 古王国阶段，王陵纪念性建筑（萨卡拉阶梯金字塔至吉萨金字塔群）是国家能力与王权意识形态的集中物质表达（通论见 Lehner、Edwards、Shaw 古王国章）。
statement.en: In the Old Kingdom, royal monumental tombs (Saqqara Step Pyramid through the Giza pyramids) concentrate expressions of state capacity and royal ideology (surveys: Lehner, Edwards, Shaw Old Kingdom chapter).

editorial.notes: Statements paraphrased from cited sections of civ-ancient-egypt.md only.
